name: IPX
steps: Open ipx.exchange/fanszn , the link on IPX's official X profile.
Press Sign in with X. The rules ask for an "X account at least 90 days old with 50+ followers (or manual review)".
Pick a fandom and take the Fan Check. You get one try, so answer fast.
Come back every day to keep your streak multiplier, and do the side tasks: Discord, Telegram and the waitlist.
Post your own content about IPX, tag @IPXExchange and submit the link for scoring. Paid posts don't count: "Anyone paid by IPX or its agencies for campaign posts is not eligible for rewards."

Check the leaderboard before 15 November at 23:59 UTC and the results on 17 November. IPX hasn't said how winners link a wallet or claim. Warning Ignore anyone who messages you about prizes. The rules say: "IPX never DMs first. Only trust ipx.exchange and x.com/IPXExchange."
what: IPX's FAN SZN pays IPX to the top 100 and $20,000 USDC to ranks 101 to 350. Free with an X account; the leaderboard closes 15 Nov.
behind: IPX's team page names Brendan McCafferty as founder and chief executive, Jordan Schlosser as co-founder and chief technology officer, Anthony Maffei as chief operating officer and Orlando Sanchez as blockchain tech lead. The terms place the operator, IPX Platform LLC, in Miami. On X, IPX announced a $4 million seed round at a $125 million valuation led by Bitsurge Holdings. Crypto Briefing reporte
costs: The sprint costs nothing. The rules say: "FAN SZN is free to play." You don't need a wallet or a deposit to collect Aura. The wider IPX platform does charge fees and asks users to "Complete required KYC/AML verification procedures", but none of that is needed for FAN SZN.
